old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a white, textured object resembling a honeycomb structure, placed on a wooden surface. The background features a dark, textured acoustic foam panel, suggesting an indoor setting, possibly a studio or workshop. A person's hand, clad in a dark-colored glove, enters the frame from the right side. The hand holds a tool, likely a chisel or a similar implement, which is used to carefully carve into the object. As the tool makes contact with the material, it creates a circular indentation, gradually deepening the hole. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on the interaction between the tool and the object. The lighting is consistent, highlighting the texture of both the object and the glove, while the acoustic foam panel provides a contrasting backdrop. The video emphasizes the precision and care taken in the carving process, showcasing the transformation of the object as the hole grows larger.

caption: The video captures a close-up of a white, pebbled foam block standing upright on a light wooden tabletop against a dark backdrop of acoustic foam panels. A broad, dark metal blade is already embedded in a notch on the block's right face. As the sequence progresses, the blade slides steadily downward, lengthening the small upper notch into a tall vertical slot through the textured surface. The block itself remains fixed in place while the cut extends downward toward its lower edge. Thin wisps of smoke begin to curl upward from the top of the incision during the later frames, marking the heated blade's contact with the material. At the right edge, a rounded reddish handle portion of the tool gradually enters view, following the blade's descent. The camera and background stay essentially still throughout, keeping focus on the carving action. The slot is still being formed throughout the visible portion, with the blade positioned low within the groove.
